id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a3e: "Welcome to Arboria, holy land and the closest place in the world to Yggdrasil.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a5d: "Welcome to Arboria, holy land and the closest place in the world to Yggdrasil.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a49: "For ages we have told the myths and watched over Yggdrasil. Please listen to what everyone has to say.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a68: "For ages we have told the myths and watched over Yggdrasil. Please listen to what everyone has to say.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a7d: "Oh, Luminary. Welcome to Arboria, holy land and the closest place in the world to Yggdrasil.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a8a: "...Though now it has fallen to earth, Yggdrasil remains the sacred being that binds our lives together.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a9e: "Since Yggdrasil fell that day, so many have died... but I thought Veronica would surely be fine.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aac: "Ugh... Veronica... I wanted to play with you more. I wanted to talk about so many things...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ab9: "The flame lit with hair offered for the dead must never die out through the night. So I keep watch like this.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1acb: "Oh... {var:1}. This morning the Elder headed to the summit, saying he had an important matter about the Luminary.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ad8: "He's probably waiting for you now. The summit is reached by the mountain path near the cathedral, so please go meet him.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aec: "Oh, Luminary. This is Arboria... a village that has lost what it worshipped.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1af5: "But we will survive. To pass on to later generations the heart of Veronica, who carried on the hope of the Luminary...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b06: "Ugh... the married ladies' spirit overwhelms me, and I can't bring myself to join their circle... I want to chat with those two!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b16: "Ugh... in the end I couldn't chat with the Luminary's two companions... The power of married ladies is fearsome...!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b24: "Ugh... in the end I couldn't chat with the Luminary's two companions... The power of married ladies is fearsome...!

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b6c: "Oh, Luminary... You headed to the cathedral with your companions. Why are you here...?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b89: "Oh, Luminary... You headed to the cathedral with your companions. Why are you here...?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b78: "With you gone, the Elder must be worried. Please go back toward the cathedral.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b95: "With you gone, the Elder must be worried. Please go back toward the cathedral.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ba5: "Oh, Luminary. You met your companions properly. I'm glad you didn't get separated.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bb3: "Oh, Luminary. You met your companions properly. I'm glad you didn't get separated.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bc0: "Luminary... Please protect us powerless people of Arboria.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bdc: "Luminary, you have a cute face. If I were ten years younger, I'd go for you... what a pity.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bea: "The land here is rich. We harvest plenty of fragrant herbs and flavorful vegetables.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c1d: "The land here is rich. We harvest plenty of fragrant herbs and flavorful vegetables.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bfc: "Oh, Luminary. You seem restless. Is something on your mind?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c05: "...Huh? What time is it now? What a strange thing to ask.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c0c: "You all just headed to the cathedral saying you'd gathered the six orbs. Aren't your companions at the cathedral?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c2b: "Oh, Luminary. Your companions were looking for you, but I'm glad you met.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c39: "Oh, Luminary. Your companions were looking for you, but I'm glad you met.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c46: "Luminary, you've grown quite manly since I last saw you. Young women won't leave you alone!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c71: "This village is the birthplace of a certain sage. She taught magic to the villagers and sang of love with her harp.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c84: "Nearly all the myths of this village are about that sage.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c92: "Ugh... I'm so hungry I can't move. My belly and back are about to touch...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d14: "Ugh... I'm so hungry I can't move. My belly and back are about to touch...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c9b: "...Oh! Luminary! You've seen me at my worst. Please don't tell anyone...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cab: "...I heard from Serena. Veronica died protecting you from the Dark One Mordegon.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cb9: "I'm so frustrated...! I couldn't even strike back at that hated Dark One. I'm so frustrated...!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cca: "Serena has been a bit dreamy since childhood. She always trailed behind Veronica.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cd6: "Veronica insisted on the search and persuaded the parents. Serena lacks the nerve to face the Dark One.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ce6: "Serena should give up traveling with the Luminary and stay with her parents. It may be best for her...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cf8: "Ugh... I drank unfamiliar liquor at Veronica's funeral and feel sick, so I can't stand up...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d03: "What would the late Veronica think if she saw me like this... Ugh... I'm pathetic...!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d1d: "But it's thanks to Veronica's courage that we're alive. I'll find food no matter what...!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d30: "Serena's mood has changed so much. Such a noble face now. I get nervous when she's near...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d47: "Serena's mood has changed so much. Such a noble face now. I get nervous when she's near...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d60: "Serena's mood has changed so much. Such a noble face now. I get nervous when she's near...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d79: "Serena's mood has changed so much. Such a noble face now. I get nervous when she's near...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d92: "Serena's mood has changed so much. Such a noble face now. I get nervous when she's near...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dab: "Serena's mood has changed so much. Such a noble face now. I get nervous when she's near...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dc4: "Serena's mood has changed so much. Such a noble face now. I get nervous when she's near...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d3b: "...Oh, Luminary! Don't tell Serena I said that!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d53: "Serena, you heard that?! I-I'm embarrassed, so please don't stare at me!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d6c: "Serena, you heard that?! I-I'm embarrassed, so please don't stare at me!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d85: "Serena, you heard that?! I-I'm embarrassed, so please don't stare at me!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1d9e: "Serena, you heard that?! I-I'm embarrassed, so please don't stare at me!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1db7: "Serena, you heard that?! I-I'm embarrassed, so please don't stare at me!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dd0: "Serena, you heard that?! I-I'm embarrassed, so please don't stare at me!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ddb: "May Sage Senya's blessing be with you wherever you go. I pray for everyone's safety...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e0b: "I'm the same age as Elder Fanard. I've witnessed countless baptism ceremonies with my own eyes.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e18: "A child baptized here is a child of Arboria. Nearly everyone in this village is like my child or grandchild.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e2a: "Phew, it's chilly. On sleepless nights, deeply steeped tea warms you nicely.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e3a: "The flowers and herbs of this village I tended all along have all withered...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e42: "Without plants, insects, birds, and beasts can't survive. This world draws closer to death each day...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e55: "No new tea leaves can be picked, and the tea I'm drinking is nearly gone...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e60: "It's old tea forgotten at the back of the shelf, so it smells a bit moldy... Ugh... I want fresh tea.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e71: "Veronica and Serena were hope itself to us who watched Yggdrasil fall up close. And yet...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e7e: "The Dark One steals everything we live for: hearts, lives, even hope. Only darkness remains...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e91: "Another precious life has vanished... However irreplaceable, people are lost in an instant...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e9e: "I've seen too much sorrow and I'm tired. I'd rather be seen off than see young ones off.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eb0: "Since the Dark One was born the land has lost its vitality. But I learned a few plants still sprout.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ebf: "I'm studying which plants can survive. With luck even potatoes might grow.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ece: "Hmm... so this is the antidotal herb tea that's popular lately. Better than dead leaves, but bitter...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1edd: "Lately the withered land has regained vitality and plants are growing. Soon we'll harvest food too.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1efb: "Lately the withered land has regained vitality and plants are growing. Soon we'll harvest food too.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eeb: "Eat your fill and sleep well... Then you can think much more positively about things.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fb4: "I've lived in this village for years, but never felt such an ominous air on my skin.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fd0: "I've lived in this village for years, but never felt such an ominous air on my skin.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fbf: "An old man like me has no regrets, but I hope young folk like the Luminary stay safe.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fdb: "An old man like me has no regrets, but I hope young folk like the Luminary stay safe.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2008: "I've seen many baptism ceremonies, but a new life being blessed is always a fine thing.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2015: "Luminary, they call you the child of Yggdrasil. I'm sure you too were blessed by Yggdrasil and born into this world.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2029: "Many life leaves have scattered since then... Everyone's crushed by grief at losing their old lives.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|204b: "Many life leaves have scattered since then... Everyone's crushed by grief at losing their old lives.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2036: "Some, overwhelmed, follow the dead. Others die of illness or hunger. But Luminary, stay strong.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2057: "Some, overwhelmed, follow the dead. Others die of illness or hunger. But Luminary, stay strong.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|206c: "I've long wondered why they were born twins, and perhaps...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2076: "Did Yggdrasil foresee that Serena would survive thanks to Veronica? Fate is truly cruel...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|208a: "Veronica and Serena were one in heart. Even before the journey they were always together, close sisters.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2096: "I think Veronica will go on living in Serena's heart.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20a3: "Oh... Serena's hairstyle isn't the only change. Her whole impression has changed.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20ab: "This air... yes. It resembles the portrait of Sage Senya I once saw in an old text.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20be: "Many life leaves scattered, and everyone was crushed by grief at losing their old lives...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20dd: "Many life leaves scattered, and everyone was crushed by grief at losing their old lives...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20ca: "We'll try a little longer. Otherwise we couldn't face Veronica, who gave her life for the future...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20e9: "We'll try a little longer. Otherwise we couldn't face Veronica, who gave her life for the future...

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21ef: "Just after witnessing a baptism blessing a new life, the Luminary's star has fallen...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21fd: "I don't mind what becomes of me, but I hope the sprouts of Arboria stay safe.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2224: "No one may enter beyond this point. It's a sacred place, the Elder told me. Please turn back.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2234: "No one may enter beyond this point. It's a sacred place, the Elder told me. Please turn back.

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2245: "...You look deeply troubled. I understand, but Luminary, please don't blame yourself.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2255: "...Oh, Luminary. Beyond here is the sacred ground of Arboria's people. Why are you here alone at midnight?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2274: "Good morning, {var:1}. Early this morning the Elder passed through here and headed for the summit of Zwaardsrust.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2281: "He said to let you through when you came. I don't know what happened, but please go meet the Elder.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2292: "Luminary's Peak was long guarded as sacred ground to keep people out, but that no longer seems necessary.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22a1: "Now that Cetacea is summoned, there's nowhere you can't go. I pray for your safe journey.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22b3: "Well, well, Luminary! The star of today's feast, where are you headed?!

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22bf: "Come now, go back to the plaza and tell everyone tales of your valor against the Dark One!

id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|237b: "Beyond is a sacred place called Luminary's Peak. The Elder said the Luminary may pass.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23a6: "Oh! At last, this day...! I always thought the Luminary would visit! Please, come in!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23b2: "If the Luminary stays here, this inn will be told of as a legendary inn for generations!
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23c4: "Oh, Luminary! Thank you for coming to such a humble inn. Now then...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23d2: "My wife died after Yggdrasil fell. Now I run the inn alone.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23eb: "My wife died after Yggdrasil fell. Now I run the inn alone.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|23fe: "...My wife died before me. I always thought it wouldn't be so lonely if I had a child.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|240a: "But watching people cry over losing their child like that, I'm not sure how I feel anymore...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|241d: "Luminary, you can't sleep... No wonder, after traveling with Veronica all that time.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2429: "There's still time before dawn. Why not take a walk? I'll be here the whole time.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2438: "After you went to bed, the Elder came at dawn. He seemed to have business with you.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2447: "When I said you were still resting, he looked thoughtful and headed for the summit. What happened...?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|245c: "Hello, Luminary. As the owner I'm proud that you stayed even once at this inn.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2482: "Oh, Luminary...! You must be tired, so please come in.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|249c: "My, my! Thank you for coming to such a small inn.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24a3: "Guests rarely came, but I made the beds every day so I'd be ready whenever one did.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24d0: "Handling the Luminary's money makes me nervous. Now then...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24e2: "Since the world fell into chaos, some squandered recklessly and others hoarded food... but no one came out ahead.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|24fb: "That family was always close. When they were blessed with Veronica and Serena, the couple was overjoyed.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2508: "They never dreamed this day would come... Sob... ugh...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2515: "Veronica's parents were drowning in grief, so Serena arranged and ran nearly all the funeral herself.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2523: "Thanks to her the funeral went smoothly, but I worry about Serena, holding back her grief...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2536: "Late one night I heard a harp. That unique melody... was it left by the ancient sage Senya?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|255c: "Late one night I heard a harp. That unique melody... was it left by the ancient sage Senya?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2546: "I don't know much about music, but I was surprised Senya left such a sad song.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|256c: "I don't know much about music, but I was surprised Senya left such a sad song.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25a0: "Our god is Yggdrasil itself. I too will pray for the Luminary chosen by Yggdrasil.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25d0: "Oh, Luminary! If my goods will do, please gear up here. Now then...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25e2: "Oh, Luminary! If my goods will do, please gear up here. Now then...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25f3: "Good materials are scarce now, so when we lack materials for tools and gear, we break up unneeded furniture.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|261a: "Good materials are scarce now, so when we lack materials for tools and gear, we break up unneeded furniture.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2601: "I'd lie if I said it wasn't hard, but I keep going for the customers who come. Please keep patronizing us.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2629: "I'd lie if I said it wasn't hard, but I keep going for the customers who come. Please keep patronizing us.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|263b: "So Serena has Veronica's staff... We made it specially at our shop when the two set out.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2647: "I hope that staff supports Veronica as she's called to Yggdrasil...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2655: "For a long time I brewed tea from dead leaves, but for the first time in months I made real tea.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2662: "When no one can even think of tomorrow, hoarding is pointless. First, we must soothe our ravaged hearts...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|267a: "The wife of the young couple who lost their child has started talking a little. She seems a bit better.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2688: "They say recovering from losing someone takes half the time you spent with them. Will the Luminary be all right...?
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26a5: "I made Veronica's staff specially when she set out. I wonder if it helped her...
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26ea: "I hear the Luminary lost both the hometown that raised you and your birth country. How pitiful.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26f7: "When the journey ends, if you need a place to live, live in this village. Everyone would surely be glad.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2708: "Sigh... No more tea to pick, so I substitute dead leaves, but it's undrinkable.
id./param/region/r016.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2712: "But drinking tea at this shop is my daily joy. Not even the Dark One can ruin that habit.

tm.「天空を見上げ 長時間 祈っていたので\n じつは 首を痛めましてな……。\n: "I prayed gazing at the sky for so long that I hurt my neck... It still hasn't healed. Ow, ow...
tm.「世界で もっとも 命の大樹に近い場所……\n 聖地ラムダへ ようこそいらっしゃ: "Welcome to Arboria, holy land and the closest place in the world to Yggdrasil.
tm.「私たちは 長い時の間\n 神話を語り 命の大樹を見守ってきました。\n どうぞ: "For ages we have told the myths and watched over Yggdrasil. Please listen to what everyone has to say.
tm.「まあ 勇者さま。\n 世界で もっとも命の大樹に近い場所\n 聖地ラムダへ よ: "Oh, Luminary. Welcome to Arboria, holy land and the closest place in the world to Yggdrasil.
tm.「……今や 地に落ちてしまいましたが\n 命の大樹が 私たちの命を束ねる\n 聖: "...Though now it has fallen to earth, Yggdrasil remains the sacred being that binds our lives together.
tm.「あの日 命の大樹が落ちてから\n 大勢の人が 亡くなっていったけど……\n ベ: "Since Yggdrasil fell that day, so many have died... but I thought Veronica would surely be fine.
tm.「うぅっ……ベロニカ……。\n もっと あなたと 遊びたかった。\n もっと 色: "Ugh... Veronica... I wanted to play with you more. I wanted to talk about so many things...
tm.「故人のために 髪を手向けた炎は\n ひと晩中 絶やしてはいけない掟……。\n: "The flame lit with hair offered for the dead must never die out through the night. So I keep watch like this.
tm.「あら……{var:1}さま。\n 今朝 長老さまが 勇者さまのことで\n 大切: "Oh... {var:1}. This morning the Elder headed to the summit, saying he had an important matter about the Luminary.
tm.「きっと今頃 勇者さまを待っているはずです。\n 山頂なら 大聖堂近くの山道から: "He's probably waiting for you now. The summit is reached by the mountain path near the cathedral, so please go meet him.
tm.「まあ 勇者さま。\n ここは……聖地ラムダ。\n もう 崇めるものを 失った里: "Oh, Luminary. This is Arboria... a village that has lost what it worshipped.
tm.「ですが 私たちも 生きのびてみせます。\n 勇者さまという希望をつないだ ベロ: "But we will survive. To pass on to later generations the heart of Veronica, who carried on the hope of the Luminary...
tm.「うう……奥さまたちの気迫に負けて\n あの輪に入っていく自信がないわ……。\n: "Ugh... the married ladies' spirit overwhelms me, and I can't bring myself to join their circle... I want to chat with those two!
tm.「うう……結局 勇者さまの お仲間ふたりと\n おしゃべりできなかった……。\n: "Ugh... in the end I couldn't chat with the Luminary's two companions... The power of married ladies is fearsome...!
tm.「あら 勇者さま……。\n 仲間の皆さんと 大聖堂へ向かったはずなのに\n なぜ: "Oh, Luminary... You headed to the cathedral with your companions. Why are you here...?
tm.「勇者さまが いなくなって\n きっと 長老さまが 心配していますわ。\n 大聖: "With you gone, the Elder must be worried. Please go back toward the cathedral.
tm.「まあ 勇者さま。\n お仲間の皆さんと ちゃんと会えたんですね。\n はぐれた: "Oh, Luminary. You met your companions properly. I'm glad you didn't get separated.
tm.「勇者さま……。\n 我ら チカラなき 聖地ラムダの民を\n どうか お守りくだ: "Luminary... Please protect us powerless people of Arboria.
tm.「勇者さま 意外と かわいいカオしてるのね。\n オバちゃんも あと１０年若かっ: "Luminary, you have a cute face. If I were ten years younger, I'd go for you... what a pity.
tm.「この辺りは 土地が豊かでね。\n 香りのいいハーブや 味の濃い野菜が\n たく: "The land here is rich. We harvest plenty of fragrant herbs and flavorful vegetables.
tm.「おや 勇者さま。\n なんだか 落ち着かない様子だけど\n 気になることでも: "Oh, Luminary. You seem restless. Is something on your mind?
tm.「……えっ？ 今は いつだって？\n いやはや おかしなことを聞くもんだねえ。: "...Huh? What time is it now? What a strange thing to ask.
tm.「６つのオーブを集めおわった とか言って\n みんなで 大聖堂に向かったばかりじ: "You all just headed to the cathedral saying you'd gathered the six orbs. Aren't your companions at the cathedral?
tm.「おや 勇者さま。\n お仲間が 探していたようだけど\n ちゃんと会えたようで: "Oh, Luminary. Your companions were looking for you, but I'm glad you met.
tm.「勇者さまは ちょっと見ないうちに\n ずいぶん 男らしくなったねえ。\n こり: "Luminary, you've grown quite manly since I last saw you. Young women won't leave you alone!
tm.「この里は ある賢者さまの出身地でしてね。\n 賢者さまは 里の者たちに 魔法を: "This village is the birthplace of a certain sage. She taught magic to the villagers and sang of love with her harp.
tm.「この里に伝わっている神話は ほとんど\n その賢者さまにまつわるものばかりです: "Nearly all the myths of this village are about that sage.
tm.「うぅ……。\n お腹がすいて もう 動けない……。\n もう お腹と背中がくっ: "Ugh... I'm so hungry I can't move. My belly and back are about to touch...
tm.「……はっ！ 勇者さま！\n お恥ずかしいところを 見せてしまいました。\n ど: "...Oh! Luminary! You've seen me at my worst. Please don't tell anyone...
tm.「……セーニャから 話は聞きました。\n ベロニカは 魔王ウルノーガの手から\n: "...I heard from Serena. Veronica died protecting you from the Dark One Mordegon.
tm.「私は くやしい……！\n 憎き魔王に 一矢報いることもできないなんて\n くや: "I'm so frustrated...! I couldn't even strike back at that hated Dark One. I'm so frustrated...!
tm.「セーニャは 子供の時から ちょっと\n ぼんやりしたところが ありましてね……: "Serena has been a bit dreamy since childhood. She always trailed behind Veronica.
tm.「勇者さまを探す旅に出ると 決意したのも\n 両親を説得したのも すべて ベロニ: "Veronica insisted on the search and persuaded the parents. Serena lacks the nerve to face the Dark One.
tm.「もう セーニャは 勇者さまとの旅はあきらめて\n 両親と一緒にいたほうが いい: "Serena should give up traveling with the Luminary and stay with her parents. It may be best for her...
tm.「うぅ……。\n ベロニカの葬儀で 飲みなれないお酒を飲んだら\n 気持ちが悪く: "Ugh... I drank unfamiliar liquor at Veronica's funeral and feel sick, so I can't stand up...
tm.「こんな私を見たら 亡きベロニカは\n いったい どう思うだろうか……。\n う: "What would the late Veronica think if she saw me like this... Ugh... I'm pathetic...!
tm.「しかし……ベロニカの勇気があってこそ\n 今の私たちが 生きていられるんだ……: "But it's thanks to Veronica's courage that we're alive. I'll find food no matter what...!
tm.「セーニャって ずいぶん雰囲気が変わったなあ。\n あんなに りりしいカオになっ: "Serena's mood has changed so much. Such a noble face now. I get nervous when she's near...
tm.「……って 勇者さまじゃないですか！\n 今のは セーニャにはナイショですよ！: "...Oh, Luminary! Don't tell Serena I said that!
tm.「って セーニャ 聞いてたのか！？\n は 恥ずかしいから\n あんまり じっと: "Serena, you heard that?! I-I'm embarrassed, so please don't stare at me!
tm.「勇者さまの 行く先に\n 賢者セニカさまの ご加護がありますように。\n 皆さ: "May Sage Senya's blessing be with you wherever you go. I pray for everyone's safety...
tm.「ワシは ファナード長老と 同い年でな。\n もう 何度となく 洗礼の儀式を\n: "I'm the same age as Elder Fanard. I've witnessed countless baptism ceremonies with my own eyes.
tm.「洗礼の儀式を受けた子は 聖地ラムダの子……。\n この里の人間は もう だいた: "A child baptized here is a child of Arboria. Nearly everyone in this village is like my child or grandchild.
tm.「ふぅ……冷え込みますのう。\n 眠れない夜は 深く蒸したお茶が\n よく あた: "Phew, it's chilly. On sleepless nights, deeply steeped tea warms you nicely.
tm.「ワシが ずっと 世話をしてきた\n この里の花も ハーブも\n みんな 枯れて: "The flowers and herbs of this village I tended all along have all withered...
tm.「植物がなければ 虫も 鳥も\n 獣も 命をつなげることはできぬ。\n この世界: "Without plants, insects, birds, and beasts can't survive. This world draws closer to death each day...
tm.「もう 新しい茶葉も取れなくなったし\n こうして 飲んでいるお茶も\n たくわ: "No new tea leaves can be picked, and the tea I'm drinking is nearly gone...
tm.「棚の奥に忘れられていた 古いお茶だから\n ちょっぴり カビくさいのう……。\: "It's old tea forgotten at the back of the shelf, so it smells a bit moldy... Ugh... I want fresh tea.
tm.「ベロニカと セーニャのふたりは\n 大樹が落ちるさまを 間近で見た我らにとって: "Veronica and Serena were hope itself to us who watched Yggdrasil fall up close. And yet...
tm.「魔王は 人の心も 命も 希望さえも\n 生きるよすがの すべてを奪ってゆく……: "The Dark One steals everything we live for: hearts, lives, even hope. Only darkness remains...
tm.「また ひとつの 尊い命が消えてしもうた……。\n どんなに かけがえのない人も: "Another precious life has vanished... However irreplaceable, people are lost in an instant...
tm.「悲しいものを見すぎて ワシは 疲れた……。\n 若者を 見送る側になるよりも\: "I've seen too much sorrow and I'm tired. I'd rather be seen off than see young ones off.
tm.「魔王が誕生してから 大地に生気が無くなった。\n しかし そんな中でも わずか: "Since the Dark One was born the land has lost its vitality. But I learned a few plants still sprout.
tm.「今 どういう植物が生き残れるのか\n 研究しているところじゃよ。\n うまくい: "I'm studying which plants can survive. With luck even potatoes might grow.
tm.「うーむ……これが 最近はやりの\n どくけしそうの お茶か……。\n 枯れ葉よ: "Hmm... so this is the antidotal herb tea that's popular lately. Better than dead leaves, but bitter...
tm.「最近 枯れた大地も 生気を取り戻し\n 植物が 育つようになってきた。\n そ: "Lately the withered land has regained vitality and plants are growing. Soon we'll harvest food too.
tm.「ハラいっぱい食べて よく眠る……。\n そうすれば もっともっと 物事を\n: "Eat your fill and sleep well... Then you can think much more positively about things.
tm.「ワシは 何年も この里で過ごしてきたが\n このような まがまがしい空気を\n: "I've lived in this village for years, but never felt such an ominous air on my skin.
tm.「ワシのような老人は 心残りもないが\n 勇者さまのような 若者たちは\n どう: "An old man like me has no regrets, but I hope young folk like the Luminary stay safe.
tm.「これまで何度も 洗礼の儀式を見てきたけど\n 新しい命が 祝福されるっていうの: "I've seen many baptism ceremonies, but a new life being blessed is always a fine thing.
tm.「大樹の申し子と言われる 勇者さま。\n きっと あなたも 命の大樹に祝福されて: "Luminary, they call you the child of Yggdrasil. I'm sure you too were blessed by Yggdrasil and born into this world.
tm.「あれから たくさんの命の葉が散って……。\n みんな 今までの暮らしを失った悲: "Many life leaves have scattered since then... Everyone's crushed by grief at losing their old lives.
tm.「思いあまって 後を追う者……。\n 病気や 食べ物がなくて死ぬ者もいるけど\n: "Some, overwhelmed, follow the dead. Others die of illness or hunger. But Luminary, stay strong.
tm.「私はずっと ふたりが どうして\n 双子で生まれてきたのか 考えてきましたが\: "I've long wondered why they were born twins, and perhaps...
tm.「ベロニカの助けで セーニャが生き残ることも\n 命の大樹は 見越していたのでし: "Did Yggdrasil foresee that Serena would survive thanks to Veronica? Fate is truly cruel...
tm.「ベロニカと セーニャは 一心同体。\n 旅に出る前から いつも 一緒にいて\n: "Veronica and Serena were one in heart. Even before the journey they were always together, close sisters.
tm.「これからも セーニャの心の中で\n ベロニカは 生き続けると思うよ。: "I think Veronica will go on living in Serena's heart.
tm.「おや……。\n 今のセーニャは 髪型もだけど\n ずいぶん 印象が変わったよう: "Oh... Serena's hairstyle isn't the only change. Her whole impression has changed.
tm.「この雰囲気は……そうそう。\n 昔 古文書で見た 賢者セニカさまの肖像画と\n: "This air... yes. It resembles the portrait of Sage Senya I once saw in an old text.
tm.「たくさんの命の葉が散って みんな\n 今までの暮らしを失った悲しみに\n 打ち: "Many life leaves scattered, and everyone was crushed by grief at losing their old lives...
tm.「もう少しだけ……私たちは がんばってみます。\n そうでないと 未来のために: "We'll try a little longer. Otherwise we couldn't face Veronica, who gave her life for the future...
tm.「世界中の人々が 平和になったことを\n 各地で よろこび合っているようですね。: "People everywhere seem to be rejoicing at the world's peace. The news reaches even this remote place.
tm.「勇者さま もう世界は回られましたか？\n 世界中の人々にも その勇姿を見せたら: "Luminary, have you toured the world yet? If everyone saw your valor, I'm sure they'd be delighted.
tm.「洗礼の儀式で 新しい命の祝福を\n 見届けたばかりというのに\n 勇者の星が: "Just after witnessing a baptism blessing a new life, the Luminary's star has fallen...
tm.「わしは どうなってもいいが\n 聖地ラムダの 若芽には\n どうか 無事でいて: "I don't mind what becomes of me, but I hope the sprouts of Arboria stay safe.
tm.「この先は なんぴとも 立ち入ってはならぬ\n 聖なる地と 長老から ことづかっ: "No one may enter beyond this point. It's a sacred place, the Elder told me. Please turn back.
tm.「……ずいぶん 思いつめたカオをしていますね。\n 気持ちはわかりますが 勇者さ: "...You look deeply troubled. I understand, but Luminary, please don't blame yourself.
tm.「……おや 勇者さま。\n ここから先は 我らラムダの民の聖なる地。\n 真夜中: "...Oh, Luminary. Beyond here is the sacred ground of Arboria's people. Why are you here alone at midnight?
tm.「おはようございます {var:1}さま。\n 今朝早くに 長老さまが ここを通: "Good morning, {var:1}. Early this morning the Elder passed through here and headed for the summit of Zwaardsrust.
tm.「勇者さまが来たら 通すように……だそうです。\n 何があったのか わかりません: "He said to let you through when you came. I don't know what happened, but please go meet the Elder.
tm.「勇者の峰は 長い間 聖なる地として\n みだりに人が入らぬよう 守ってきました: "Luminary's Peak was long guarded as sacred ground to keep people out, but that no longer seems necessary.
tm.「ケトスが呼びだされた今 勇者さまにとって\n もはや 行けない所は ないでしょ: "Now that Cetacea is summoned, there's nowhere you can't go. I pray for your safe journey.
tm.「やあやあ 勇者さま！\n 今日の宴の主役ともあろう お方が\n どちらへ 向か: "Well, well, Luminary! The star of today's feast, where are you headed?!
tm.「さあさ 早く 広場に戻って\n みんなに 魔王を倒した時の武勇伝でも\n 聞か: "Come now, go back to the plaza and tell everyone tales of your valor against the Dark One!
tm.「この先は 勇者の峰と呼ばれる聖地。\n 長老からは 勇者さまなら\n お通しし: "Beyond is a sacred place called Luminary's Peak. The Elder said the Luminary may pass.
tm.「おぉっ！ ついに この日が……！\n いつか 勇者さまが訪れると思っていました: "Oh! At last, this day...! I always thought the Luminary would visit! Please, come in!
tm.「勇者さまが お泊まりになったら\n この宿は 後世まで 伝説の宿屋として\n: "If the Luminary stays here, this inn will be told of as a legendary inn for generations!
tm.「おぉ 勇者さま！\n このような むさくるしい宿に\n よくぞ いらしてくれま: "Oh, Luminary! Thank you for coming to such a humble inn. Now then...
tm.「ウチの女房は 大樹が落ちた後に\n 亡くなってしまいましてね……。\n 今は: "My wife died after Yggdrasil fell. Now I run the inn alone.
tm.「……オレは 女房に先立たれましてね。\n せめて 子供がいてくれれば\n さび: "...My wife died before me. I always thought it wouldn't be so lonely if I had a child.
tm.「でも あんな風に 我が子に先立たれて\n 泣いている人の姿を見ていると なんだ: "But watching people cry over losing their child like that, I'm not sure how I feel anymore...
tm.「勇者さま 眠れないのですね……。\n ベロニカとは ずっと一緒に\n 旅をして: "Luminary, you can't sleep... No wonder, after traveling with Veronica all that time.
tm.「まだ 夜明けまで 時間がありますし\n 散歩でも してきてはいかがでしょう。\: "There's still time before dawn. Why not take a walk? I'll be here the whole time.
tm.「勇者さまが お休みになった後\n 明け方 長老さまが いらっしゃいましてね。\: "After you went to bed, the Elder came at dawn. He seemed to have business with you.
tm.「勇者さまなら まだ お休みだと伝えると\n 考え込んだ様子で 山頂へ向かってい: "When I said you were still resting, he looked thoughtful and headed for the summit. What happened...?
tm.「やあ 勇者さま。\n 一度でも この宿に泊まっていただけて\n 主人として 鼻: "Hello, Luminary. As the owner I'm proud that you stayed even once at this inn.
tm.「おぉ 勇者さま……！\n なにかと お疲れでしょうから\n どうぞ お入りくだ: "Oh, Luminary...! You must be tired, so please come in.
tm.「あらあら まあまあ！\n このような 小さな宿に\n よくぞ いらしてくれまし: "My, my! Thank you for coming to such a small inn.
tm.「お客さまは めったに来ませんでしたが\n いつ お見えになっても こまらないよ: "Guests rarely came, but I made the beds every day so I'd be ready whenever one did.
tm.「勇者さまのお金を あつかうなんて\n なんだか 緊張しますわ。さて……: "Handling the Luminary's money makes me nervous. Now then...
tm.「世界が乱れてから ヤケになって 散財する人や\n 食料の買いだめに走る人がいま: "Since the world fell into chaos, some squandered recklessly and others hoarded food... but no one came out ahead.
tm.「あの一家は みんな 仲のいい家族でしてね。\n ベロニカとセーニャを 授かった: "That family was always close. When they were blessed with Veronica and Serena, the couple was overjoyed.
tm.「まさか こんな日が来るなんて\n 夢にも思ってなかったでしょうに……。\n う: "They never dreamed this day would come... Sob... ugh...
tm.「ベロニカの両親は 悲しみに暮れていましたから\n 葬儀の手配や進行などは ほと: "Veronica's parents were drowning in grief, so Serena arranged and ran nearly all the funeral herself.
tm.「おかげで 葬儀は 無事に終わりましたが\n 悲しみをこらえ がんばっていたセー: "Thanks to her the funeral went smoothly, but I worry about Serena, holding back her grief...
tm.「先日 夜中に 竪琴の音が聞こえておりましたが\n あの独特な調べは いにしえの: "Late one night I heard a harp. That unique melody... was it left by the ancient sage Senya?
tm.「私は あまり 音楽にくわしくないのですが\n セニカさまの残したものに あんな: "I don't know much about music, but I was surprised Senya left such a sad song.
tm.「我らの神は 命の大樹そのもの……。\n 大樹に選ばれし 勇者さまのため\n 私: "Our god is Yggdrasil itself. I too will pray for the Luminary chosen by Yggdrasil.
tm.「まあ 勇者さま！\n ウチの品物でよければ ぜひ\n 身仕度を していってくだ: "Oh, Luminary! If my goods will do, please gear up here. Now then...
tm.「あまり いい素材が取れなくなったから\n 道具や武具の材料が 足りない時は\n: "Good materials are scarce now, so when we lack materials for tools and gear, we break up unneeded furniture.
tm.「つらくないと言えば ウソになりますが\n 来てくれる お客さまがいると がんば: "I'd lie if I said it wasn't hard, but I keep going for the customers who come. Please keep patronizing us.
tm.「セーニャが持っている ベロニカの杖ね……。\n ふたりが旅立つ時に ウチの店で: "So Serena has Veronica's staff... We made it specially at our shop when the two set out.
tm.「あの杖が 命の大樹のもとへ召される\n ベロニカを 支えてくれればいいんだけど: "I hope that staff supports Veronica as she's called to Yggdrasil...
tm.「長い間 枯れ葉で お茶をいれてましたが\n 何か月ぶりかに ちゃんとした\n: "For a long time I brewed tea from dead leaves, but for the first time in months I made real tea.
tm.「みんなが 明日のことさえ 考えられない時に\n 物をためこんでも しょうがない: "When no one can even think of tomorrow, hoarding is pointless. First, we must soothe our ravaged hearts...
tm.「お子さんを亡くされた 若夫婦の奥さん\n ちょっとだけど 話すようになってくれ: "The wife of the young couple who lost their child has started talking a little. She seems a bit better.
tm.「人を失った悲しみから 立ち直るまでには\n その人と過ごした時間の半分が必要だ: "They say recovering from losing someone takes half the time you spent with them. Will the Luminary be all right...?
tm.「ベロニカの遺品の杖は あの子が旅立つ時に\n 私が 特別に こしらえた物なので: "I made Veronica's staff specially when she set out. I wonder if it helped her...
tm.「勇者さまは 育った故郷も 生まれた国も\n 全部 失ってしまったんだってねえ。: "I hear the Luminary lost both the hometown that raised you and your birth country. How pitiful.
tm.「旅が終わった後 住む場所に こまったら\n この里で 暮らしなさいな。\n み: "When the journey ends, if you need a place to live, live in this village. Everyone would surely be glad.
tm.「はぁ……。\n お茶が取れなくなったから そこらの枯れ葉で\n 代用しているん: "Sigh... No more tea to pick, so I substitute dead leaves, but it's undrinkable.
tm.「でも この店で お茶を飲むのが\n あたしの 毎日の楽しみなんだ。\n この習: "But drinking tea at this shop is my daily joy. Not even the Dark One can ruin that habit.
